description: Hand Aurgus your rebate agreement — PASTE its text, or DROP a PDF/scanned document (pass it as file_base64). Aurgus reads the terms with its deterministic parser (and CV/OCR for a PDF/scan — a Python CPU service, ZERO LLM): customer, basis (whole-volume / incremental / cliff), rate or tier ladder, and the rebate period. A CPU parser proposes spans, deterministic rules produce every value, and anything it can't read cleanly is flagged for your eye rather than guessed. Nothing is created until a person reviews and certifies the terms in the browser — this is how the agreement (and the ASC 606 treatment it implies) gets set up, before any transaction data is asked for.

file_base64.description: A PDF or scanned-image agreement, base64-encoded. Aurgus reads it with CV/OCR (zero LLM). Provide this OR text.

filename.description: The original filename (e.g. 'rebate-agreement.pdf') — used to sniff the file type and shown on the review page.

text.description: The agreement's text (paste the full agreement, or the rebate clauses). Provide this OR file_base64.

name: ingest_agreement
